clues.text: In Eden, he gave names to all the livestock, the birds of the air, and every beast of the field.
God put him into a deep sleep in the garden and took one of his ribs to make a woman.
After he ate from the forbidden tree, God told him the ground was cursed and he would toil.
In the list of generations in Genesis, he lived a total of 930 years and then died.
Writing to the Romans, Paul says death reigned from him until Moses.
Writing to Corinth, Paul says that as in him all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
Jude says Enoch, who prophesied the Lord coming with myriads of holy ones, was seventh from him.
